People crack me up. No one wants to make a bold difficult stand but let #MeToo or #BlackLivesMatter start trending and then everyone is on board.

We would have no movements and no change if no one made bold moves.

These “pro-lifers” get me.

They are so pro life but never show up for #BlackLivesMatter. Just to be clear they are not pro-life, they are anti-abortion. 

They advocate so hard for a fetus to be seen as human but fall short on human rights.
